extracted.name: Strawberry Lassi
extracted.description: This creamy strawberry lassi is a blend of yogurt, milk, and ripe strawberries served over ice for a sweet, frothy, and refreshing chilled drink.
instruction_lines: Cut 3 strawberries into small pieces and set aside. Place remaining strawberries and sugar into a blender; blend on high speed for 30 seconds. Pour in milk and blend another 30 seconds. Add yogurt and blend on high speed for 1 minute.
Place 1 ice cube in each of 3 glasses and pour in lassi. Top with reserved strawberry pieces and serve.
